products.name: Whey Protein Isolate
products.shortDescription: Fast-absorbing whey isolate with 27g of protein per scoop.
products.description: A low-carb, low-fat whey protein isolate designed to help you reach your daily protein target without a lot of extra calories. Mixes easily in water or milk.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop (30g) with 200-250ml of water or milk. Take after training or between meals.

products.name: Whey Protein Concentrate
products.shortDescription: Everyday whey blend for building and maintaining muscle.
products.description: A classic whey concentrate that covers your daily protein needs at an accessible price. A solid everyday option alongside a balanced diet.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop (33g) with 250ml of water or milk, 1-2 times per day.

products.name: Casein Protein Night
products.shortDescription: Slow-digesting protein, best taken before bed.
products.description: Micellar casein digests slowly, making it a popular choice in the evening or during longer gaps between meals.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop (35g) with 250-300ml of water or milk before bed.

products.name: Creatine Monohydrate 500g
products.description: A straightforward, unflavored creatine monohydrate that can be added to any drink or shake. One of the most studied supplements for strength training.
products.usage: Take 1 scoop (5g) daily, any time of day, with water or in a shake.

products.name: Mass Gainer 5kg
products.shortDescription: High-calorie shake for those struggling to gain weight.
products.description: A calorie-dense blend of protein and carbohydrates for people who need extra calories to support size and strength goals.
products.usage: Mix 2-3 scoops with 400-500ml of milk or water, 1-2 times per day between meals.

products.name: Multivitamin Complete
products.description: A once-daily tablet formulated to help fill common gaps in a busy or restrictive diet.
products.usage: Take 1 tablet daily with a meal.

products.name: Vitamin D3 + K2
products.shortDescription: Vitamin D3 with K2, in easy-to-swallow softgels.
products.description: A combined D3/K2 softgel, useful for people who get limited sun exposure throughout the year.
products.usage: Take 1 softgel daily with a meal containing fat.

products.name: ZMA Zinc & Magnesium
products.shortDescription: Zinc, magnesium and B6, taken before bed.
products.description: A well-known combination of zinc, magnesium and vitamin B6 in capsule form, typically taken in the evening.
products.usage: Take 3 capsules 30-60 minutes before bed, ideally on an empty stomach.

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate
products.shortDescription: A gentler, well-absorbed form of magnesium.
products.description: Magnesium bound to glycine, chosen by people who find other forms of magnesium harsh on the stomach.
products.usage: Take 2 capsules daily, with or without food.

products.name: Pre-Workout Extreme
products.shortDescription: Energy, focus and pump before your session.
products.description: A pre-training formula combining caffeine with common pump and focus ingredients. Contains stimulants - not recommended late in the day.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop with 200-300ml of water, 20-30 minutes before training. Avoid taking after 4pm.

products.name: BCAA 2:1:1
products.shortDescription: Branched-chain amino acids in the classic 2:1:1 ratio.
products.description: A BCAA powder in the standard 2:1:1 ratio, often taken during or around training sessions.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop with 300-400ml of water, sipped during training.

products.name: L-Glutamine
products.shortDescription: Unflavored glutamine powder for daily use.
products.description: A simple, unflavored glutamine powder that can be added to a shake or drink at any point in the day.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop (5g) with water or add to your regular shake, once or twice daily.

products.name: Fat Burner Thermo
products.shortDescription: A stimulant-based capsule for cutting phases.
products.description: A thermogenic capsule intended to be used alongside a calorie-controlled diet and regular training, not as a replacement for either.
benefits: Contains caffeine and green tea extract
products.usage: Take 2 capsules in the morning with food. Do not exceed 2 servings per day.

products.name: Omega 3 Fish Oil
products.shortDescription: Fish oil softgels with EPA and DHA.
products.description: A everyday fish oil supplement to help fill gaps for people who don't eat oily fish regularly.
products.usage: Take 1-2 softgels daily with a meal.

products.name: Electrolyte Hydration Mix
products.shortDescription: A light electrolyte mix for training in the heat.
products.description: A low-sugar electrolyte powder for topping up sodium, potassium and magnesium during long or hot training sessions.
products.usage: Mix 1 scoop with 500ml of water before, during or after training.

products.name: Shaker Bottle 700ml
products.description: A durable 700ml shaker bottle with a stainless steel mixing ball, for lump-free shakes on the go.
